about: A FIXTURE for the preview cases (SPEC-preview-sites.md § 2; PV1, PV4, PV6): the manifest a preview's --from carries beside its <delivery>.json, data/photo-sheets.json's shape for one week, its cells keyed by the week's names (a preview's names are Fit AF's, so its file's `name`). The sheet it names is NOT committed here: the cases write it into their temporary copy of this directory as a byte copy of test/fixtures/photo-sheets/chefs-choice-2026-10-04.jpg (generated flat colours, 24 × 72: three 24 × 24 cells). Three of the week's meals have a cell; the others get plain tiles.
